text: dsh-fs-retry 是一个 DSH 文件系统插件，通过包装 ctx.fs.writeText，在文件写入遇到 Windows ReplaceFileW 或 Win32 1175 错误时进行有限次数的退避重试；其他错误会直接抛出。它会尝试包装文件系统原型和实例的 writeText 方法，保留原调用参数与返回值，并在无法改写时记录提示。适合 Windows 环境中目标文件可能短暂被占用、希望文件写入调用自动重试的 DSH 用户。需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本。

dsh-fs-retry is a DSH filesystem plugin for Windows. It wraps ctx.fs.writeText and retries ReplaceFileW or Win32 1175 errors with backoff, up to eight attempts; other errors are rethrown. It preserves arguments and results when files are briefly held. Requires Node.js 22 or later.
Windows 上文件写入偶尔报 1175，能自动重试吗？
让 DSH 的文本文件写入在 ReplaceFileW 失败后稍等再试。
Can DSH retry a text file write when Windows briefly blocks the target file?
dsh-fs-retry 的功能「Windows 写入重试」：包装 ctx.fs.writeText，遇到 Win32 1175 或 ReplaceFileW 错误时退避重试，最多 8 次；其他错误或重试耗尽后抛出原错误。
dsh-fs-retry README · dsh-fs-retry：Retry `ctx.fs.writeText` on Windows `ReplaceFileW` failures (Win32 **1175**).

dsh-fs-retry README · Why：On Windows, `dsh-fs-local` publishes file writes with `ReplaceFileW`. When the target
is briefly held (indexer, AV, cloud-sync filter), it fails with `Win32 1175` and the
whole tool call dies — even though a retry succeeds.

Measured on one machine (`D:` volume, 8k random chars, 50 rounds per directory):

dsh-fs-retry README · Why：| operation | failures |
|---|---|
| `ReplaceFileW` on `C:` (3 dirs) | 0 / 40, 0 / 40, 0 / 40 |
| `ReplaceFileW` on `D:` (3 dirs) | 18 / 40, 9 / 40, 20 / 40 |
| `MoveFileEx(MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)` on `D:` | 0 / 40 |
| `ReplaceFileW` + up to 5 backoff retries on `D:` | 0 / 50 |

dsh-fs-retry README · Why：`chkdsk /scan` clean; suspending every user-mode candidate (AV GUI, indexer, backup
agent) did not change the rate. The volume carries `wcifs` and `FileCrypt` filter
instances that the working volume does not — that is the working theory, not a
proven cause.

Upstream fix belongs in `dsh-fs-local`: fall back to `rename` on any Windows replace
failure, not only on `ENOENT`. Until that lands, this plugin retries at the service
boundary.

dsh-fs-retry README · Install：Lives in a DSH profile, not in `app.asar` — app updates do not overwrite it.

```bash
dsh-fs-retry README · add a junction (Windows) or symlink so the profile can resolve it：mklink /J "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-fs-retry" "D:\tools\dsh-fs-retry"
section: add a junction (Windows) or symlink so the profile can resolve it

text:
dsh-fs-retry README · Verify：Startup log should show:

```
[fs-retry] 已装载（原型 ok / 实例 ok，重试 8 次）
```

Then write repeatedly to the affected volume and confirm no `Win32 1175` reaches the
tool call. Each retry logs `第 N 次遇到 1175，退避后重试`.

Run the offline self-test:

```bash
node selftest.mjs
```

Three cases: retries then succeeds · non-1175 is not retried · gives up after 8
attempts (~340 ms of backoff).
dsh-fs-retry README · Rollback：Remove the row from `cordis.patch.yml` and delete the junction. Nothing else is touched.

dsh-fs-retry README · Behaviour：- Only `writeText` is wrapped; `read`/`edit`/`diff` are untouched.
- Only errors whose message matches `Win32 1175` or `ReplaceFileW` are retried.
- 8 attempts, delay `12 ms × attempt`. Worst case ≈ 340 ms before the original error
  surfaces unchanged.
- Arguments and return value pass through untouched; the error type on final failure
  is the original one.
